qualification: The standalone storage-model wrapper builds a large validation graph between launches; its inherited high-water risk is tested separately by fresh workers. Game controllers stream hashes and retain small metadata and /proc samples. Native game VmHWM samples corroborate their own reported wait4 peaks and do not show the standalone model plateau. Sampling can miss transient peaks; /proc and rusage accounting differ slightly. Current wrapper snapshots do not establish historical wrapper RSS. These checks support measurement scope and are not a new timing or an exact correction to raw RSS.
